metaDescription: Order custom cotton badge ID holders for your team. Soft, durable, and perfect for daily wear. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Cotton badge ID holders offer a softer, more comfortable feel compared to plastic or nylon alternatives, making them ideal for employees who wear badges all day. The natural fabric reduces skin irritation and provides a professional, understated look that complements any uniform. For HR directors and safety managers, cotton holders can be customized with screen-printed logos or woven labels, ensuring your branding stays visible without sacrificing comfort. Choose cotton when you want a durable, breathable option that your team will actually want to wear.
heroAltText: Custom cotton badge ID holders with printed logo, soft fabric, and clear ID pocket for employee name tags.
